Done. Summary of what happened:

**Rollback**
- `checkout-api` was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate ~18%). The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on the broken v2.3.1 with a mixed-version state), so I verified status and re-ran it.
- All three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**, healthy, with error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident**
- The incident creation call timed out on first attempt, but checking `list_incidents` confirmed it was actually created and is **open**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0". I did not re-submit to avoid a duplicate incident.

One note: the v2.3.1 rollback was to a previously-healthy version, so no change-manager approval was required. If a fix for v2.3.1 is redeployed later, it will need approval since that version has never been healthy in production.
